card.situation:
National Park Service solicitation (PMIS 340733A) for hazard tree removal and pruning at a Lakewood, CO site, period of performance 09/28/2026–03/31/2027, total small business set-aside.
Reached the owner because Red Cedar is SBA/WOSB/EDWOSB eligible and holds NAICS 561730, but two owner-rule hard limits and a core capability gap were flagged.
reasons_for: Red Cedar is fully eligible for the total small business set-aside as a WOSB/EDWOSB/SBA firm, removing any eligibility barrier to bidding [set_aside_note].
The firm holds NAICS 561730, carries OSHA 30 supervisors, and has a QC program that partially supports the safety and traffic-control plan requirement [a06d61e1-d186b0f7-p1-3e072167].

Federal contracting experience with GSA, Tinker AFB, and VA demonstrates procedural familiarity with SAM registration, SCA wage compliance, and federal quotation submission [a06d61e1-d186b0f7-p1-429be8cb].
reasons_against: Place of performance is Lakewood, CO (~900 miles from Oklahoma City), a hard disqualifier under owner rule [rc-distance] prohibiting bids over 200 miles from Oklahoma City [a06d61e1-d186b0f7-p1-b32e6385].

The period of performance is approximately 6 months (09/28/2026–03/31/2027), a hard disqualifier under owner rule [rc-base] prohibiting bids under a 12-month base period [a06d61e1-cd66a3af-p1-680211f7].

The firm profile lists no hazard tree removal, arborist, ISA certification, tree-climbing/rigging, or chainsaw/aerial-lift capability — the core technical scope of this contract [a06d61e1-cd66a3af-p1-680211f7].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB), Economically Disadvantaged WOSB (EDWOSB), and SBA-certified small business headquartered in Oklahoma City, OK, with active federal contracting experience across GSA, Department of Veterans Affairs, and Department of Defense installations including Tinker AFB.

Red Cedar holds NAICS 561730 (Landscaping Services) and maintains a workforce of 38 W-2 employees supported by OSHA 30-certified field supervisors. Our quality control program logs inspections in a CMMS, enabling documented daily field coordination consistent with COR check-in requirements. We are enrolled in e-Verify and maintain compliance with Service Contract Act wage determinations and Executive Order minimum wage obligations on all federal contracts.

Our safety infrastructure includes site-specific work and safety plan development capability, drawing on OSHA 30 supervisor expertise and familiarity with 29 CFR 1910 general industry standards. We operate a green procurement program and are experienced with federal administrative requirements including SAM registration maintenance, IPP invoicing, SF-1444 wage classification submissions, and FAR subcontractor vetting procedures.

Red Cedar is committed to full compliance with all applicable local, state, and federal codes and regulations, and to transparent, responsive communication with the Contracting Officer and COR throughout performance.

Point of Contact: [Owner Name], Red Cedar Facility Services, Oklahoma City, OK | [Phone] | [Email] | SAM UEI: [UEI] | NAICS: 561730

Work is to be performed at a National Park Service site, with on-site activities restricted to 6:30 AM to 3:00 PM, Monday through Friday. The contractor must submit a site-specific work/safety and traffic-control plan before mobilization and coordinate with the COR at least five days prior to planned mobilization.
